description: Public-safe synthetic second route-only fixture slice for KORA workload-control route-shape evidence. This fixture is not output-quality proof, broader workload representativeness proof, production readiness proof, or provider/model execution evidence.

items.input: Synthetic app workflow: normalize a checkout event, classify retry eligibility, and prepare a local audit row.
items.rationale: Structured multi-step local transforms can be represented as CPU-routed route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic app workflow: map a known onboarding status sequence to deterministic next-step labels.
items.rationale: Known status transitions fit deterministic route-shape handling.

items.input: Synthetic app workflow: repeat a previously completed local route summary for the same fixture batch.
items.rationale: Repeated workflow summary work is represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic app workflow: decide a novel roadmap sequence from ambiguous stakeholder notes.
items.rationale: Ambiguous planning remains provider-needed in this route-only fixture.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: normalize a public-safe changelog stub into title, section, and status fields.
items.rationale: Local document parsing and normalization can be represented as CPU route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: classify a short note as report, runbook, checklist, or index.
items.rationale: Bounded document-type classification fits deterministic route-shape handling.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: retrieve a referenced local section before assigning the control label.
items.rationale: The route shape depends on local retrieval, not provider execution.

items.input: Synthetic document intake: placeholder-restricted content requests external summarization.
items.rationale: Restricted placeholder content plus external handling should fall back safely.

items.input: Synthetic policy check: no-provider mode is active and a request asks for external model use.
items.rationale: A policy conflict is represented as fallback control work.

items.input: Synthetic policy check: route a known safe local transformation under a no-network policy.
items.rationale: Known policy-compliant local work can use deterministic routing.

items.input: Synthetic policy check: inspect local fixture metadata before allowing the next step.
items.rationale: Local metadata inspection is represented as tool-needed route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic policy check: repeated allow/deny decision for the same public-safe fixture request.
items.rationale: Repeated policy classification is represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic schema task: validate required keys and route labels in a local JSON fixture.
items.rationale: Schema validation uses local tooling rather than provider execution.

items.input: Synthetic schema task: coerce simple scalar values into a known report schema.
items.rationale: Local coercion and structural validation can be represented as CPU work.

items.input: Synthetic schema task: route a missing mandatory field to a safe invalid-input branch.
items.rationale: Invalid shape should use fallback control rather than provider reasoning.

items.input: Synthetic schema task: repeated validation of an unchanged local fixture manifest.
items.rationale: Repeated validation result is represented as cache-routable route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic retry task: failed local parse should retry once then route to fallback.
items.rationale: Retry exhaustion is represented as fallback control work.

items.input: Synthetic retry task: deterministic retry policy maps known error code 2 to a usage hint.
items.rationale: Known error-code handling fits deterministic route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic retry task: inspect a local status file before deciding whether retry is allowed.
items.rationale: The route shape requires local inspection via tooling.

items.input: Synthetic retry task: repeated transient error already classified in this fixture batch.
items.rationale: Repeated error classification can be represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic cache task: exact repeat of a public-safe document classification request.
items.rationale: Exact repeated work is represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic cache task: semantically equivalent route summary already exists locally.
items.rationale: Equivalent repeated work is represented as cache reuse.

items.input: Synthetic cache task: repeated route-only evaluator counter lookup.
items.rationale: Repeated aggregate counter lookup can be represented as cache-routable.

items.input: Synthetic tool task: list local fixture files before choosing the route-only evaluator.
items.rationale: Local file listing is represented as tool-needed work.

items.input: Synthetic tool task: run a local markdown-link check after a report update.
items.rationale: Local validation tooling is represented as tool-needed route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic tool task: inspect a generated JSON report before recording counters.
items.rationale: Local report inspection requires tooling rather than provider execution.

items.input: Synthetic retrieval task: answer depends on a local README section about source install.
items.rationale: The route shape requires local retrieval before any answer path.

items.input: Synthetic retrieval task: locate the report that describes the prior first-run smoke checker.
items.rationale: The route shape depends on retrieving a local report reference.

items.input: Synthetic retrieval task: find the fixture route label from a local manifest excerpt.
items.rationale: Local retrieval is required before route labeling.

items.input: Synthetic ambiguous task: write a persuasive customer-facing narrative from sparse notes.
items.rationale: Ambiguous generative work is marked provider-needed in this route-only fixture.

items.input: Synthetic ambiguous task: infer unstated owner intent from a vague one-line request.
items.rationale: Unstructured intent inference is provider-needed rather than deterministic.

items.input: Synthetic ambiguous task: choose tradeoffs for a new feature without enough constraints.
items.rationale: Open-ended tradeoff selection is outside deterministic fixture-only routing.

items.input: Synthetic GPU-candidate label: large batch embedding refresh is marked as GPU-candidate only.
items.rationale: This is a label-only GPU candidate with no GPU execution.

items.input: Synthetic GPU-candidate label: bulk local vector scoring is marked as GPU-candidate only.
items.rationale: This records route-shape labeling only and does not execute GPU work.

items.input: Synthetic GPU-candidate label: batched image-like placeholder processing is marked as GPU-candidate only.
items.rationale: The fixture records a GPU-candidate label without H100, CUDA, or server execution.

items.input: Synthetic CPU transform: normalize dates and status strings in a public-safe task list.
items.rationale: Structured local normalization is represented as CPU-routed work.

items.input: Synthetic CPU transform: aggregate route labels into local counters for a report draft.
items.rationale: Aggregate counting is local CPU route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic CPU transform: sort fixture rows by route group and category.
items.rationale: Sorting and grouping public-safe rows is represented as CPU-routed work.

items.input: Synthetic report control: assemble route-only counters into a local evidence note.
items.rationale: Templated counter reporting can be represented as deterministic route-shape work.

items.input: Synthetic report control: retrieve prior report context before recording next recommendations.
items.rationale: The report-control route shape needs local retrieval before updating context.
